name: Double E Pipeline Project / Dude Lateral
researcher_notes: Double E Pipeline, LLC filed a prior notice request on June 11, 2026 (FERC docket CP26-542) under its blanket certificate to build the Dude Lateral Project: a 22.1 mile, 20-inch lateral with a new meter station in Eddy and Lea Counties, New Mexico, estimated cost $38 million (Federal Register notice 2026-12847, June 25, 2026). The EIA August 2026 release (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 47, status Applied) adds 400 MMcf/d, from Marlan meter station in Eddy County to a new Dude meter station in Lea County, serving a proposed Kinetik Dude gas processing plant, with 330,000 Dth/d committed. EIA and the Federal Register notice are two different origins for length, diameter and cost, but EIA is one release; capacity rests on EIA alone. Not an existing row: P0061 is the 135.2 mi main line; P5727 Red Hills Lateral is cancelled, 20 mi, 24 in, from Poker Lake, a different project. Meets the add threshold: sponsor named, endpoints known, permit request filed, length 22.1 mi = 35.6 km, above the 25 km minimum. Owner and Parent left blank here: the sheet already carries Summit Midstream Partners LP 70 percent and ExxonMobil 30 percent for the Double E rows, and no source opened here states them for this lateral, so copy from P0061 at apply time. Interstate pipe, but the sheet type for the Double E rows is transmission. Route: not searched or mapped; no official GIS found yet. Medium confidence on status as proposed (prior notice request pending, protest period open; blanket requests become automatic approvals if no protest). Capacity is a single-source EIA figure.
